impact: Incumbent exchanges moving into 24/7 tokenized stocks puts more competition on HOOD's tokenized-equity push and COIN's plans.
summary: Ava Labs said Avalanche will be the core ledger for the clearing firm behind NYSE's planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform, which still needs regulatory approval. AVAX rose as much as 10%.
title: NYSE picks Avalanche for tokenized stock platform, AVAX up 10%
